items.title: Roland Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: He was sort of like a Paul Robeson type person, just big voice, great big smile, happy man.

ctx.x: Did the citizens of those countries respond to what you played?

Yes. The people would come, and most of the time they were young people, they were between the ages of eight and seventeen or sixteen. They would respond, yes. And sometimes they’d come up and try to talk to us and ask us how did we learn or how long have you been playing or questions like that. Oh yes they responded. don’t know where he is now, but he was quite an open singer, an open person. And he had a tremendous personality. Being an actor, they would gravitate to him. And the overflow would come and ask me a few questions, because I am the accompanist in that case. But I think he handled everything very well. They really liked it.
